description: This 3D model preview displays an overhead pot rack, ideal for kitchen organization. The rack is crafted from a light gold or brass-toned metal, featuring a robust rectangular top bar supported by angled brackets. Below this, an oval-shaped grid shelf, matching the metallic finish, provides additional storage space. Three pots or pans, each with a lustrous copper or rose gold finish and black handles/hooks, hang neatly from the grid. Designed likely for ceiling mounting, this pot rack offers a practical and space-saving solution for cookware, blending industrial functionality with a touch of modern elegance.
